title: Week 1 Expense Entry
prompt: Build the Week 1 command-line expense entry: normalise and parse amount text, validate amount and category, calculate a summary, and present a clear success or failure result.
successCriteria: The program has explicit examples for every required failure path.
Parsing, validation, and formatting are separate focused functions.
Invalid external text cannot crash the program.
A manual trace documents data at every pipeline stage.
hints: Write input-output examples before completing the functions.
Keep raw String handling near the boundary and typed logic inside.
solutionOutline: Implement parsing, validation, and presentation contracts.
Coordinate explicit failure branches in main.
Trace and refine the program with one change at a time.
verification: Run positive, zero, negative, non-numeric, and blank-category examples.
Predict each result before running and explain any mismatch.
